text:
maria: Quick sync: we need to finalize alpha acceptance criteria for the observability console. Focus: dashboards + sampling config UI + cost rollups + error-slice alerts. Who can own each acceptance check?
sam: I can own the dashboard acceptance. Quick ask: do we want per-model or per-route as primary axis? Customers asked for per-route first.
diego: Per-route makes billing easier. Also propose tenant-level rollups and CSV export for finance.
nina: From SRE: retention and RBAC matter. Alpha should default to 7d retention for telemetry and have a toggle for 30d behind an enterprise flag. Also admins-only access to cost exports.
rachel: Product note: Customers want an "estimate now" button that shows per-request cost before issuing heavy calls. That needs a server-side estimator using model.profile and token_count.
maria: Good. Owners: dashboards=sam, cost-estimator=rachel, sampling UI=diego, RBAC+retention=nina, alerting=diego. Is that workable?
diego: Yes. For sampling UI I'm proposing a small form under route config with three knobs: global_pct, error_force_capture (bool), per_route_override_pct. UI schema sketch:```json
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "global_pct": 1,
  "per_route_override_pct": 0,
  "error_force_capture": true
}
```
sam: For dashboards alpha we'll ship a single reusable tile set: latency distribution, success rate, cost/time series (sampled), and top error traces. Keep tiles configurable but not fully customizable.
analytics-bot: analytics-bot: prototype telemetry schema v0.3 uploaded -> https://internal.redwood/telemetry/schema/v0.3
nina: Policy questions: who can flip per-route overrides? Ops or route owners? Suggest route-owners + org-admins. We'll add an audit log entry for each override change.
rachel: (typo correction) @rachel not @drachel
ops-bot: ops-bot: created audit-log stream "obs-alpha-audit" for event types: sampling_change, export_requested, cost_estimate_run
rachel: Thanks. For the cost estimator the accuracy targets: within 10% of actual billed sample on pilot data. It can use static model profiles plus live token_count histogram. We'll need a nightly reconciliation job for drift detection.
maria: Launch criteria draft for alpha (vote):
  A) UI: EyesOn dashboard available in product console for pilot orgs
  B) Sampling: per-route sampling config and header support (X-RD-SAMPLE) with server enforcement
  C) Cost: estimator endpoint + CSV export for 7d rollups, RBAC enforced
  D) Alerts: error-slice alerting with configurable threshold + documented runbook
  E) Safety: storage cap and retention defaults in place, admin controls behind feature-flag
  F) Perf: tracing hook overhead <1.5% in median path for pilot workload
sam: +1 for A/B/C/D/E. For F, can we set target as <1% median, <3% p99? engineering constraints may make p99 looser.
diego: We can commit to <1% median if we keep payloads minimal. We need to instrument and measure during canary.
nina: Canary plan: rollout to 2% traffic for pilot org 1, monitor latency, CPU and telemetry topic lag. Roll forward criteria: no latency regression >1% median and no sustained telemetry topic lag >30s for 15m.
rachel: Customer acceptance checklist (for pilot): 1) finance signs off CSV format; 2) SRE signs off retention and rollback plan; 3) product reviews dashboard copy; 4) pilot customers run acceptance test harness (we'll provide k6 scripts).
maria: Decision call: Are exports and RBAC blocking for alpha? We could ship a simplified CSV export (no PII) and require manual request to run full exports. This reduces infra scope. Vote?
sam: I'd prefer simplified CSV now rather than blocking. Pilot customers need something to reconcile costs.
diego: Agreed. We'll hide PII-collected fields and keep export limited to admin roles.
nina: SRE OK with simplified export as long as we have audit logs and retention limits.
maria: OK final: simplified CSV export + admin-only. We'll add a backlog ticket for full export pipeline.
ops-bot: ops-bot: feature-flag "obs-alpha-export-admin" created.
analytics-bot: analytics-bot: telemetry retention enforcement configured to 7d for alpha topics.
maria: Next steps: owners to file short RFCs with acceptance checklists and perf runbook by EOD Thursday. We'll hold a 30m review on Friday to sign-off pilot readiness. Thanks. :thumbsup:
